work.title: Plato, Euthyphro
work.notes: Plato's dramatic representation of a Socratic inquiry into piety. Preserve the dialogue's question-and-answer structure and do not present its dilemma as a verbatim historical transcript.

edition.label: Benjamin Jowett translation in Standard Ebooks' Dialogues, 2022
edition.licenseNote: The EPUB states that the source text and artwork are believed public domain in the USA and that Standard Ebooks' contributions are dedicated worldwide under CC0 1.0. Verify source-text rights in the deployment jurisdiction.

passages.citationLabel: Plato, Euthyphro 10a, Jowett trans., Standard Ebooks
passages.translationText: The point which I should first wish to understand is whether the pious or holy is beloved by the gods because it is holy, or holy because it is beloved of the gods.
passages.interpretiveNote: The question distinguishes a thing's being approved because it is good from its being good merely because it is approved. Its force is methodological: test causal and definitional direction rather than accept circular explanations.
passages.period: Platonic representation of Socrates; historical English translation in a modern public-domain edition
